title: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Spicy Sichuan-style chicken stir-fry with peanuts and vegetables.
instructions:
1. Cut chicken into bite-sized cubes and marinate with soy sauce, rice wine, and cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Prepare the sauce: mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch.
3. Heat oil in wok over high heat.
4. Stir-fry chicken until just cooked, then remove.
5. Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns to the wok, fry until fragrant.
6. Add bell peppers and onions, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
7. Return chicken to wok, add sauce and peanuts.
8. Toss everything together until sauce thickens.
9. Serve immediately with rice.
